items.title: Pakistani FM: 20 Iranian sailors to be transferred to Islamabad Friday night
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Pakistani Foreign Minister Muhammad Ishaq Dar announced that the operation to repatriate 20 Iranian and 11 Pakistani sailors, left stranded following the US detention of their vessel in Singaporean waters, has succeeded, and all are being flown today from Thailand to Islamabad.

items.title: Iran’s Deputy FM meets AALCO Sec-Gen
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Kazem Gharibabadi, the Deputy Minister for Legal and International Affairs, met with the Secretary-General of the Asian-African Legal Consultative Organization (AALCO) Kamalinne Pinitpuvadol on Friday.

items.title: Iraq forms new government with only 14 of 23 ministers
items.summary: Iraq’s parliament approved the new government six months after parliamentary elections in November 2025. Ali al Zaidi is now the prime minister, but key ministries remain unfilled amid disagreements between Tehran and Washington and their partners over the government’s formation. The post Iraq forms new government with only 14 of 23 ministers appeared first on FDD's Long War Journal .

items.title: Araghchi reiterates Iran’s historical duty as protector of security in Hormuz
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA - Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in a message has stressed Iran’s historical duty as protector of security in Hormuz.

items.title: Baqaei: Kurds are guardians of borders and backbone of Iran’s power
items.summary: Sanandaj, IRNA – Esmaeil Baqaei, the spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, has said the people of Kurdestan, through their resilience, understanding, and high political awareness, have played a very valuable role in protecting the country’s borders and frustrating the enemies.

items.title: Iran terms UK’s fresh sanctions as baseless
items.summary: London, IRNA – Iran Embassy in the UK has called on the UK government to reconsider and reverse anti-Iran measures, refrain from imposing unilateral coercive measures, including sanctions based on baseless allegations and political motivations.

items.title: Araghchi: Strait of Hormuz is not closed, as far as we’re concerned
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said as far as we are concerned, the Strait of Hormuz is not closed, especially for friendly countries and this restriction applies only to our enemies.

items.title: Araghchi: Iran only responds to language of respect
items.summary: New Delhi, IRNA – Foreign Affairs Abbas Araghchi has expressed hope for the return of rationality to the negotiation, and said Iran only responds to the language of respect.

items.title: Leader: Persian language one of greatest capacities for promoting Iran’s rich culture
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei has termed Persian language and literature as one of the greatest capacities for promoting the rich culture and civilization of Islamic Iran on the global stage.

items.title: Reforming UNSC not a choice but necessity, says FM Araghchi
items.summary: New Delhi, IRNA– Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has emphasized that reforming the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) is not a choice, but a necessity for the survival of the United Nations.

items.title: Araghchi holds talks with South African counterpart in New Delhi
items.summary: New Delhi, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with his South African counterpart, Ronald Lamola, on the sidelines of the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on Friday.

items.title: ‘Harmonizing in Tehran’s Wounded Synagogue’ held near Rafinia Synagogue
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – The event titled “Harmonizing in Tehran’s Wounded Synagogue” took place on Thursday evening near the Rafinia Synagogue, with the attendance of the Minister of Cultural Heritage, Tourism, and Handicrafts, Reza Salehi-Amiri.

items.title: Iran, India FMs discuss bilateral ties, regional developments, multilateral cooperation
items.summary: New Delhi, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and his Indian counterpart Subrahmanyam Jaishankar have discussed bilateral relations, regional developments, and multilateral cooperation.

items.title: In photos: Harmony in wounded synagogue of Tehran
items.summary: The Iran Activists Network held a gathering on May 14, 2026, in Tehran’s Rafinia Synagogue, which was bombarded and destroyed in the terror attacks conducted by the Israeli and American regimes, to honor those killed in the war of aggression against Iran. Minister of Cultural Heritage, Tourism and Handicrafts Reza Salehi-Amiri took part in the event.

items.title: Expanding Tehran-Baghdad relations top priority of Iran’s foreign policy: FM Araghchi
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has emphasized that enhancing the friendly and brotherly relations between Tehran and Baghdad is a top priority in Iran’s foreign policy.

items.title: In photos: Arabic version of Imam Khamenei’s memories about his father was unveiled in Tehran
items.summary: The book "Hekayat al-Sayyed" (The Story of the Sayyed) was unveiled in Tehran on May 14, 2026. The book contains the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei's memories about his father Seyyed Javad.

items.title: Arabic version of memories of Martyr Khamenei about his father unveiled in Tehran
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – The Arabic version of the memories of the former leader of the Islamic of Revolution, Martyr Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, about his father, Ayatollah Seyyed Javad Khamenei, has been unveiled.

items.title: In Talks with Israel, Lebanon is Walking a Thin Line
items.summary: This week, Israel and Lebanon are holding their third round of unprecedented direct talks on crucial issues, including borders, the disarmament of Hizballah, and ongoing Israeli military action. The United States, which is clearly driving these talks, views them expansively as seeking a “comprehensive peace and security agreement,” although one that is contingent on Lebanese action against Hizb...

items.title: Araghchi and Modi discuss war, regional security
items.summary: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on Thursday.
